entry.title: Old Książ ruins
entry.note: The dressed portal faces the downslope approach, with the pointed gallery along the long wall tracing the ravine side. Individual footings follow the retained terrain. The fitted stairs and upper landing join both sides of the portal, and a gap retains the mapped trail through the return wall.
